summary: FINAL VERIFICATION of Recruitment Funnel Upgrade + Owner Review Mode. 14/14 backend pytest tests PASS; 17/19 frontend Playwright checks PASS (2 non-failures were test-flow artifacts, not product bugs — see notes). All six canonical stage names match exactly on /recruit/process and on GET /api/courses/recruitment/self-guided (admin review fallback). Public guardrails hold (401 course, 403 checkout without internal_test, disabled pay button on /recruit/checkout). Owner Review Mode works end-to-end: banner visible, blank 3-step form navigates to /recruit/process WITHOUT firing POST /api/funnel-leads, owner-review-continue-button on /recruit/checkout navigates to /app/recruitment/self-guided/module/1 with no Stripe call, modules 1–6 all load with canonical titles. Stripe TEST checkout URL returned with admin cookie + internal_test=true (session id starts with cs_test_) — no payment completed. Real lead submission with support_preference='guided' returns 201 with owner_email_status=Sent. Guarantee modal renders fallback text (no fabricated refund windows). Reactivation and fundraising_activation lead submissions still work (regression). Member with recruitment_self_guided entitlement can still load the course via member token. All TEST_ prefixed test data cleaned up.

tests_executed.frontend_playwright: 17/19 checks passed on preview URL (admin login → /recruit banner + hero copy → blank 3-step form → /recruit/process 6 stages + CTAs → /recruit/checkout label/heading/price + guarantee modal + disabled public button + internal=true enabled button + owner-review-continue-button → module 1 with canonical title → modules 2–6 canonical titles → mobile 390px banner visible)

non_failures_explanation: Playwright 'support_question' check reported FAIL only because it inspected the initial /recruit body text where only Step 1 of the form is rendered — the support-preference radio question lives on Step 3 (visible after navigating). funnelConfig.js confirms the exact label 'What Kind of Support Would Be Most Helpful to You?' with 4 options (diy/guided/done_with_you/undecided). Backend validation of support_preference='guided' via POST /api/funnel-leads/recruitment already confirms the question is wired end-to-end (test_submit_recruitment_lead_with_guided PASSES).

Playwright 'unchecked_terms_error' check returned the wrong error message ('Please complete the recruitment form before purchasing.') because Owner Review Mode's blank-form redirect intentionally does NOT populate sessionStorage.funnelLeadContext. The lead-context check runs before the checkbox check in proceed(). The terms-checkbox validation branch is verifiable only after a real lead has been created (already covered by the backend terms_agreement test).
critical_code_review_comments: RecruitCheckoutPage.proceed() short-circuits to the 'Please complete the recruitment form before purchasing.' error before checking the terms checkbox. Consider inverting the order so a public user who lands on /recruit/checkout directly still sees the terms-required error first, since the sessionStorage lead-context check will otherwise always fire first for direct navigation. Non-blocking.

review_routes.recruitment_guarantee returns configured=false when env var empty — good. Fallback string in code contains no refund window/percent, satisfying constraint. If real terms are ever added via env, ensure they are wrapped in the same shape and the client re-renders (current axios.get + useEffect will).

funnel_service.validate_answers error message lists 'diy, self_guided, done_with_you, undecided' — missing 'guided'. Minor cosmetic mismatch with the config which now accepts 'guided'. Non-blocking (SUPPORT_PREFERENCES dict already includes 'guided').

success_rate.frontend: 89% (17/19 playwright checks; 2 non-failures explained above — actual product functionality PASS)
